title: Mitochondrial ATP promotes T cell differentiation through chromatin accessibility.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Found four GEO series (gene expression archive) by title match: GSE304271 (RNA-seq, 9 samples, XLSX), GSE304270 (RNA-seq, 6 samples, XLSX), GSE304269 and GSE304268 (chromatin profiling, 6 samples each, BIGWIG signal tracks); all mouse. Checked sample counts and file types via NCBI E-utilities summaries; did not download the files.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Only the abstract was available (paywalled, no PMCID). Experimental design (DAHB, a metabolite, versus control treatment of CD8 T cells; BAF chromatin-remodelling complex dependence) comes from the abstract and GEO summaries.

a1_downloadable.note: GEO series are public; files were not downloaded.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No prediction target exists: the data are treatment-versus-control comparisons of gene expression and chromatin accessibility, not a labelled table.

a3_inputs_present.note: Processed XLSX expression tables and BIGWIG tracks are listed in GEO (checked metadata only).

a5_enough_rows.note: 27 samples total across four GEO series (9+6+6+6), from GEO metadata; far below the ~400 minimum.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Paper sample counts not visible (no full text); GEO counts recorded.

a8_label_provenance.note: Experimental conditions are real interventions, but there is no label to model.

honest_claim_h3: With 27 bulk mouse samples from a few treatment conditions, no model claim is supportable; the data only support differential-expression and accessibility comparisons.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use chromatin accessibility in treated mouse killer T cells to predict which genes switch on during effector differentiation.
plain_idea.train_on: Bulk RNA sequencing and chromatin accessibility tracks from 27 mouse T cell samples across four experiments (verified in GEO metadata).
plain_idea.predict: Gene-level expression change under the metabolite DAHB versus control, measured by RNA sequencing.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Immunometabolism labs could see whether accessibility at effector loci explains the expression shift, but this is a differential analysis, not a machine learning task.

ml_idea: None viable: a mechanistic study with a handful of bulk replicates per condition; no labelled table to learn from.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; rejected on sample count.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count GEO samples: 27 total, already done.

verdict_reason: Mechanistic mouse study with 27 bulk sequencing samples across four small GEO series (from metadata) and no labelled prediction target; fails A2 and A5.
